title: No accessibility statement, licence file or OpenAPI spec; most docs undated
expected: Public accessibility statement with known issues and contact; a licence; a machine-readable API spec; dated, current docs.
actual: No accessibility statement or conformance report. No LICENSE file. No OpenAPI document (the generated Markdown reference is accurate, F-011). Of 1,429 docs files only 70 show 'Last updated', mostly August–September 2026 — before the 16 October platform-model change (no funds held), so wallet and commission pages are likely stale. The in-app legal page offers Terms, Privacy, Cookies and Seller Agreement but not the existing Refund Policy.
impact: Missing statements are expected by EU/UK accessibility law for services offered there; contributors cannot tell current docs from historical ones.
fix: Publish an accessibility statement (WCAG 2.2 AA target, known issues from this audit, contact); add a LICENSE (owner decision); generate openapi.json alongside API_REFERENCE.md; add a docs freshness check (owner + date front-matter) and archive superseded pages; add the Refund Policy tab.
